verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents an official command-line tool, `fhcli`, but its stated scope is narrow: it submits change events (Docker image creation, Jenkins deploys, CI build statuses) from CI or orchestration systems, not general platform operation. missing for 10: CLI coverage of incidents, alerts, runbooks and on-call (the docs say the API, not the CLI, covers everything the UI can do), install/auth/command reference docs, any agent- or AI-oriented CLI usage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
